o: Jumping forward several years from the events of Season Two, Season Three takes place at the height of the War of the Elves and Sauron, as the Dark Lord seeks to craft the One Ring that will give him the edge he needs to win the war, bind all peoples to his will - and at last rule all Middle-earth.

v.n: Something stirs on set. Season 3 is underway.

eps.o: War rages between the Elves and Sauron. Galadriel remembers a long-lost love. Durin welcomes home his brother... and another unexpected guest.
Tumult grips Númenor. Theo is offered a new path. The Dwarves weigh their options. The Elves learn of Sauron's plan - and debate a perilous mission.
Gandalf works to keep Rhûn out of the war. Elendil hunts a spy. Marnûkh leads Galadriel and Arondir to Gundabad as Sauron questions the orc's agenda.
At Gundabad, our heroes find less than they came for and more than they expected. Elrond brings Gil-galad an urgent mission. Durin defends his throne.
